messages:
Deploy Bot: rollout notice: new Dedicated pool 'zephyr-sfo2' is live in SFO2 (edge metro). Initial capacity: 12 instances. Pool flavor: Zephyr-A (edge-optimized). Tags: #dedicated #zephyr #sfo2 :rocket:
Rohit P: quick summary for the infra channel: Zephyr is our low-latency, power-efficient SKU tuned for short-turnaround chat and embedding workloads. Nominal VRAM ~64GB. Expect 10-20% lower p50 for short requests vs our a100 baseline.
Evelyn M: any changes to billing?
Billing Bot: billing update: new SKU 'dedicated.zephyr' effective immediately. Meter: instance-minute. Intro offer: first 30 days free for teams that attach 1+ production route + add tag `edge-early`.
Kai T: is this pool regional or zone-affine?
Platform Eng: sfo2 is an edge region - instances are single-az but backed by multi-rack networking. Best-effort locality for RU-sensitive workloads. Not recommended for strict affinity; reserve if you need that.
Rohit P: availability model: 40% reserved (commit), 60% burst for the soft-open phase. If telemetry looks stable we'll re-evaluate next week.
Evelyn M: are there any model compatibility notes? quantization?
Rohit P: supports 8-bit and dynamic 4-bit paths. We ran smoke tests on gpt-family and open-weights; no model-level changes expected. If you use large KV caches, use model_profile="zephyr-kv".
Platform Eng: routing note: default routing will prefer zephyr-sfo2 for routes with region preference set to sfo2 or edge-priority. Fallback chain: zephyr-sfo2-compat -> sfo1-standard -> global-h100. "Strict routing" toggle in Console blocks automatic fallback.
Evelyn M: what about preemption/maintenance?
Deploy Bot: ops note: instances are non-preemptible during reserved commit windows. Burst capacity may be reclaimed during planned edge maintenance (we will post windows). Subscribe to #infra-maintenance to get calendar updates.
Rohit P: how to reserve (CLI example):
```
redwood reserve --pool zephyr-sfo2 --count 2 --duration 90d --commit monthly --tags team=search edge-early
```
Evelyn M: who to contact on perf regressions?
Rohit P: @Platform Eng first; then @Infra Oncall if it's critical. Include p95 latency, error rate, and a short repro snippet or request id.
Kai T: any known caveats for batching?
Platform Eng: batching behavior slightly different due to smaller SM count; recommended batch sizes decreased by ~25% for best latency/cost tradeoff. See internal doc link: https://intra.redwood.dev/dedicated/zephyr-sfo2 (internal).
Billing Bot: reminder: label reservations with `team=` so costs map to your team dashboard.
Rohit P: rollout plan: day 0 soft-open (this), day 3 expand burst capacity to 25 instances if health checks are green, day 14 enable annual commit option in Console.
Deploy Bot: health checks running; expect short warmup metric spikes. Will post a follow-up if anything odd surfaces. :white_check_mark:
Evelyn M: thanks all. We'll test search routes this afternoon and report back.
Rohit P: thanks team 97 please escalate on >10% error or >30% tail latency increase.
